title: Fox reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- fox body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#e8732a'/>
  <!-- chest fluff -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#fbe9d0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='21' ry='18' fill='#e8732a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='33,30 28,12 44,24' fill='#e8732a'/>
  <polygon points='67,30 72,12 56,24' fill='#e8732a'/>
  <polygon points='34,27 31,17 42,25' fill='#f7a3a3'/>
  <polygon points='66,27 69,17 58,25' fill='#f7a3a3'/>
  <!-- muzzle / cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='50' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#fbe9d0'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='50' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#fbe9d0'/>
  <!-- eyes (closed, happy) -->
  <path d='M38 40 Q42 36 46 40' stroke='#3a1f0e' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 40 Q58 36 62 40' stroke='#3a1f0e' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='3.4' ry='2.6' fill='#3a1f0e'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 54 Q50 58 54 54' stroke='#3a1f0e' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='70' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e8732a'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='70' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e8732a'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <polygon points='31,64 50,70 50,88 31,82' fill='#4f7fd6'/>
  <polygon points='69,64 50,70 50,88 69,82' fill='#6fa2f0'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='70' x2='50' y2='88' stroke='#2f4f96' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- pages highlight -->
  <polygon points='34,66 48,71 48,85 34,80' fill='#dce8fb'/>
  <polygon points='66,66 52,71 52,85 66,80' fill='#eaf1fd'/>
  <!-- book lines -->
  <line x1='36' y1='70' x2='46' y2='73' stroke='#9fb6d8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='74' x2='46' y2='77' stroke='#9fb6d8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='73' x2='64' y2='70' stroke='#9fb6d8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='77' x2='64' y2='74' stroke='#9fb6d8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 88 Q88 86 90 72 Q84 78 76 78 Z' fill='#e8732a'/>
  <path d='M89 74 Q88 80 84 84 Q87 79 88 73 Z' fill='#fbe9d0'/>
</svg>
